title: gadget on wall
description: Point cloud scan of the making process at GSAPP.

tiles.label: Shattered Plaster
tiles.description: The plaster material on the workbench physically collapsed under external force during the fabrication process. The scattered debris and fractured cross-sections constitute the inevitable residue during the materialization of a concept.

title: hurry pigeon
description: Detailed scan of a concrete surface texture.

tiles.label: Pigeon Footprints
tiles.description: A set of tiny bird footprints was left on the city sidewalk while the concrete was not yet fully cured. It permanently records the physical trajectory of a bird's brief stroll across the urban surface.

tiles.label: Carved Text
tiles.description: Anthropogenic linear grooves were carved into the concrete surface, forming the names "Ale + ANYA" and a date. This carving, driven by clear subjective intent, forcibly embeds a private emotional text into the city's public infrastructure.

title: faded cat
description: Point cloud capture of an indoor sofa scene.

tiles.label: Cat Scratches
tiles.description: The leather fabric of the sofa has undergone long-term cutting and friction, leaving behind high-frequency, irregular reticulated scratches. This stems from the repeated stretching and scratching of a domestic cat. It is an accumulated physical proof of long-term biological companionship and daily behavior.
